ideas.title: Uncovering the scope of Minnesota Medicaid fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the alleged $700 million in suitcases and the involvement of Somali immigrants.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to expose the network of individuals and organizations involved in the alleged fraud
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What is the scope of the alleged fraud?
How did the fraud go undetected for so long?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant fraud scheme with far-reaching implications for the Medicaid program and the individuals involved.
